title: Rhind Mathematical Papyrus
summary: The Rhind Mathematical Papyrus is an Egyptian mathematical text written by the scribe Ahmose, who dated it to year 33 of Apophis, a king of the Hyksos Fifteenth Dynasty. It contains arithmetic and geometry problems. The British Museum gives about 1550 BC; the St Andrews MacTutor archive says around 1650 BC. A. H. Rhind bought it at Thebes about 1858.

uncertainty.note: Sources disagree: British Museum production date 1550 BC (approximate); MacTutor says written around 1650 BC. The range covers both.
